description: This file defines an Android Activity class named OpenGLES20Activity that sets up a GLSurfaceView for OpenGL ES 2.0 rendering, handling lifecycle events like onCreate, onPause, and onResume.

classes.name: OpenGLES20Activity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages a GLSurfaceView for OpenGL ES 2.0 rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets up the GLSurfaceView.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause event, pausing the GLSurfaceView rendering thread.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume event, resuming the GLSurfaceView rendering thread.
